comments.author: Derrick Swymer
comments.body:
h3. 🔍 Resolved: Available Shares Validation Implemented

This ticket has been resolved and verified successfully.

*Root Cause Analysis*:
This error occurred when the autonomous trading agent attempted a market SELL order on an asset where the total owned quantity was positive, but all or some shares were currently locked in other open or pending-cancel orders (e.g. bracket stop-loss or take-profit legs).
Since the available quantity was 0 (or less than requested), Alpaca rejected the submit_order call, which raised a critical exception and caused this bug ticket to be automatically generated.

*Fix Summary*:
# *Positions Retrieval Update*: Modified `alpaca_client.py`'s `get_positions()` to map and expose the actual `"qty_available"` field in addition to total `"qty"`.
# *Risk Guardrails Update*: Modified `guardrails.py`'s `validate_and_adjust_decision()` to evaluate SELL decisions against `"qty_available"`. If the proposed quantity exceeds available shares, it dynamically scales it down or cleanly rejects the trade prior to execution.
# *Execution Layer Safeguard*: Updated `execute_market_order()` in `alpaca_client.py` to monitor and wait for cancellations to release locked shares. If some shares remain locked (e.g. pending-cancel or during closed market hours), the order is scaled down or aborted cleanly, returning a structured abort status instead of throwing an exception.

*Verification and Testing*:
An end-to-end dry-run verification test was successfully executed by the reviewer subagent using real Alpaca credentials: 
{code:text}
Z:\python\projects\agent-trade\venv\Scripts\python.exe verify_agent.py
{code}
All components initialized correctly, active positions were successfully loaded, and risk guardrails successfully intercepted and handled trades cleanly without any system exceptions.

This ticket is now being closed as resolved.

h3. 🔍 Resolved: Available Shares Validation Implemented

This ticket has been resolved and verified successfully.

*Root Cause Analysis*:
This error occurred when the autonomous trading agent attempted a market SELL order on an asset where the total owned quantity was positive, but all or some shares were currently locked in other open or pending-cancel orders (e.g. bracket stop-loss or take-profit legs).
Since the available quantity was 0 (or less than requested), Alpaca rejected the submit_order call, which raised a critical exception and caused this bug ticket to be automatically generated.

*Fix Summary*:
# *Positions Retrieval Update*: Modified `alpaca_client.py`'s `get_positions()` to map and expose the actual `"qty_available"` field in addition to total `"qty"`.
# *Risk Guardrails Update*: Modified `guardrails.py`'s `validate_and_adjust_decision()` to evaluate SELL decisions against `"qty_available"`. If the proposed quantity exceeds available shares, it dynamically scales it down or cleanly rejects the trade prior to execution.
# *Execution Layer Safeguard*: Updated `execute_market_order()` in `alpaca_client.py` to monitor and wait for cancellations to release locked shares. If some shares remain locked (e.g. pending-cancel or during closed market hours), the order is scaled down or aborted cleanly, returning a structured abort status instead of throwing an exception.

*Verification and Testing*:
An end-to-end dry-run verification test was successfully executed by the reviewer subagent using real Alpaca credentials: 
{code:text}
Z:\python\projects\agent-trade\venv\Scripts\python.exe verify_agent.py
{code}
All components initialized correctly, active positions were successfully loaded, and risk guardrails successfully intercepted and handled trades cleanly without any system exceptions.

This ticket is now being closed as resolved.
